Weather data by Open-Meteo.com; ERA5 reanalysis, Copernicus Climate Change Service / ECMWF

transformations: GB settlement mapped with Europe/London DST
Radiation at hour h+1 copied to both half-hours starting hour h because source denotes preceding-hour mean; energy conserved
Temperature/cloud/wind linearly interpolated to half-hour interval starts from hourly endpoints
Seven prior days per sample date retained for offline past-only forecasts
